description:
Very Impressive Four Bedroom Detached Residence 

Kinsella Estates Gorey and Carnew are delighted to offer to the market this very impressive four-bedroom detached residence.

New to the market: A charming 4-bedroom detached home known as “Avalon” at Munny, Gorey, Co. Wexford. This spacious property offers 163.4 sq m of comfortable living space, perfect for family life.

Step inside to a welcoming entrance hall that sets the tone for this delightful home. The bright and airy living room features a classic fireplace, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Adjacent is a sunlit sunroom, ideal for relaxing and enjoying views of the expansive garden.

The well-appointed kitchen/dining area is the heart of the home, boasting ample storage and modern appliances. A separate dining room offers additional space for entertaining guests. A convenient utility room and guest shower room complete the ground floor.

Upstairs, you’ll find four generously sized bedrooms, each with ample natural light. The master bedroom includes built-in wardrobes, while the remaining bedrooms offer flexibility for family or home office use. A family bathroom with both a bath and shower serves the upper floor.

Outside, the property is surrounded by beautifully maintained front and rear private gardens, perfect for outdoor activities and al fresco dining. The tarmac driveway provides ample parking, ensuring convenience for family and visitors alike.

Located in a tranquil setting, yet within easy reach of Gorey town and its amenities, this home offers the best of both worlds. Viewing comes strongly recommended.
